_doc: ROOTCAUSE.EXE — Root Cause Digger (W-L1, his pick 2026-09-20, from `Pc_Simulation/Lamby Games/Mini-Games_LAmby.md` §1: Dig Dug). The second file on the companion disk beside lamby_rig.exe: shovelware the fellowship shipped, 1997. Register: operable — the programme's own game, so it may charm within Era 1's limits; the satire is the programme's (the diagnoses are its words) and it collapses on its own report. PRESS-ONLY (no WASD, ever): each press digs one cell beside Lamby and is one turn; the diagnoses move after every turn, through the tunnels the player dug. A diagnosis that reaches Lamby is APPLIED and goes back to its pocket; three applied and the programme writes its report. Press a diagnosis in the cell beside you to inflate it with a therapy word — three and it bursts ('it was only a word'). Two diagnoses in one cell glitch each other out ('fake labels'). Somewhere in the two deepest layers the AUTHENTIC MEMORY is buried; dig into it and the programme flags you. Both endings file to the record (`rootcause-memory:` flagged, `rootcause-report:`); leaving mid-game files nothing (unplayed media gets no response). ○ sandbox by the Progression Law: on the desktop from the disk, on the map as ○, one soft guide line, never required. Lamby is `drawLambyChar` (the same puppet as the rig file — the mascot before its debut, not charming yet).

_docS362levels: ⚑ S362 / H34 (his headset, 10 Nov, 20:36 — 'different designs and different questions for each level'; decision 5 of UiB job 13: three levels at most, after each he can stop or continue). One level = one descent. Level 1 is the top-level `layers` / `findings` / `quiz` / `leaflets` above, untouched; `levels` holds level 2 and level 3, each with its own eight layers, findings, chapter-review pairs (the programme's answer first, the honest answer second — the honest one scores 0 and is KEPT) and leaflets. Every line stays inside how 1990s ex-gay 'reparative' ministries named a root cause (the Lexicon's ROOT entry and `words` above: the father wound, the mother's attachment, peer rejection, gender nonconformity, emotional dependency, 'unmet needs'); the programme's words are its own, so the satire is its own and collapses (a thing 'not found' is filed as 'hidden too deep'). No statistics, no real people, no new sources. The honest lines are plain, short, true of anyone, and about the person, never the family: written under the 2026-08-17 norm.
